summary: Implemented backend auth API with 4 Vercel serverless endpoints (register, login, request-password-reset, reset-password) plus supporting utilities for password hashing (bcryptjs, salt rounds 10), JWT token generation (24h expiry, SECRET_KEY signed), and an in-memory user store keyed by phone_number. Registration validates North American and European phone formats. Password reset generates a cryptographically secure 6-digit code with 15-minute expiry and sends it via the existing Textbelt SMS integration. All endpoints use consistent error handling and prevent phone number enumeration.
